snapshot.note: Working tree was edited by parallel agents; header fingerprints pin the audited snapshot.

method: Consolidates public headers, contract JSON files, source definitions (libc/src, libc/log, stdlib/safe/src, third_party/safeclib), test-file token references and existing audit docs. A test column is NO EVIDENCE unless a dedicated test file exists and names the symbol; token mentions in shared corpora are not treated as dedicated tests.
claim: Evidence record, not a safety proof. TESTED means a dedicated test file exists; it does not imply Rust-equivalence. COMPILER-ENFORCED and RUNTIME-ENFORCED are distinct and neither implies the other.

categories.checked-ansi-s-gaps: Annex K / _s entry points that remain UNSUPPORTED (bsearch_s, qsort_s, asctime_s, ctime_s, strerrorlen_s, gets_s, tmpnam_s).
categories.compile-time-vs-runtime: COMPILER-ENFORCED rows are compile-time-only format/length macros; RUNTIME-ENFORCED rows rely on checked library calls and are NOT static guarantees.
categories.platform-backed-vs-bundled: PLATFORM_BACKED = host CRT delegation; BUNDLED = implemented in libc/src or stdlib/safe/src; UPSTREAM = vendored safeclib/musl.
categories.contract-gaps: Rows whose contract is NO EVIDENCE (no machine-readable contract entry) or whose contract is a placeholder in CONTRACT_STATUS.md.
categories.test-gaps: Rows with NO EVIDENCE in any of unit/boundary/fuzz/logging/ABI columns; never infer passing from a neighbouring test.
categories.abi-portability: ABI test evidence is limited to tests/cases/c_abi.c and tests/compat/; Windows x86 ABI and Linux CI are unverified locally (GAP_ANALYSIS.md).
